title: Morphics Skin (cosmetic only, made for one base)

base.description: Body-type node this skin is made for. By default (fit: node) it fits this node only.

form_id.description: Optional. Makes the skin exclusive to one form (for example its default look).

cost.description: For earn: the farming target (fragments or spectrum to collect).

spectrum.description: Price in the item's own Spectrum (soft currency earned in play).

prisms.description: Price in Prisms (premium currency, a mix of all spectrums).

skip.description: Prices to skip farming. Required when type is earn. Every form (morph) that is earned must have both prices.

fit.description: node (default, narrow): fits forms whose body type is exactly `base`. subtree (broad, opt-in): fits `base` and every node below it. Use subtree only for shared patterns.
